DOMAIN_PROFILE.AGENCY_DEFINITION_AND_AUTONOMY_DIMENSION: Use the declared operational definition and specify the dimension of autonomy actually exercised; no inference from human likeness. Candidate-specific role: criterion — Explicit agent–environment boundary.

REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.bearer_and_scope: A described agent together with its environment, observations, action channels and task, under an explicitly selected definition of agency.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.quantifier_and_horizon: For each consequential agency attribution in this study; no claim that all schools share necessary and sufficient conditions.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.applicability_guard: Agency terminology is used to explain or compare behavior.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.material_premises: A task boundary can be stated without hiding a material human, tool or environmental dependency.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.evaluation_rule: Recover what senses, selects and acts, what lies outside it, and which definition is being applied. A change of boundary requires the attribution to be reconsidered.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.constructed_positive_case: A thermostat is an agent under a situated feedback taxonomy while lacking the stronger mentalistic commitments of another account.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.constructed_failure_witness: Calling an entire service autonomous while its next action is selected by an undisclosed human makes the comparison indeterminate.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.nontrigger_and_cheaper_alternative: A small controller can be described directly by its input-output behavior; an agent label adds no obligatory machinery.
REQUALIFICATION_ANALYSIS.independent_judgement_and_evidence_ceili: Retain the explicit boundary as an analytical requirement, not a universal definition. Wooldridge and Jennings distinguish weak and strong notions; Franklin and Graesser offer a selected taxonomy; Luck and d’Inverno formalize a different hierarchy. Their disagreement is substantive.
